title: 102 tracked files still name a deleted Container Apps host: 22 shipped defaults and links, manifests, deploy JSON, test docs (KS-812 fixes only whatsapp-bot)
description:
**BLUF.** On develop `6fa9bf7b`, 102 tracked files still name a host under `*.azurecontainerapps.io`. Every one of those hosts is dead: the live demo is the VM at `https://demo-pk.secuura.net` (ruled for KS-812). 22 of the 102 are shipped code that falls back to, or links, a dead host (the same shape as KS-812, which fixes only the 2 `whatsapp-bot` files among them); the rest are manifests, deploy config, tests and docs. Unassigned, P3, no build. Grouped below by artefact type so the owner can split it into one PR per group.

**Recommendation.** Fix group A first (it is what a user or integrator runs into), then B to D (they are published or deployed artefacts), then E to H as a docs sweep. Per group: replace with the VM host `https://demo-pk.secuura.net`, or with the setting that carries it; change generated files at their source (`scripts/generate-openapi.ts` before `docs/openapi/secuura-api.yaml`); leave deliberate "this host is dead" notes (for example `deployment/DEPLOYMENT-ARCHITECTURE.md`'s "Old target (dead)" row) alone or say so. Group G is a different defect: Python bytecode is tracked in git.

**Detail.** Measured 2026-10-12 by Seat F 17th with `git grep -a -l -F 'azurecontainerapps.io' origin/develop` (`-a` because `grep` skips files with binary bytes silently; the control `Blockchain/Dev/CLI-AGENT-INSTRUCTIONS.md` is hit 20 times). 5 dead suffixes appear: `kindtree-935b2ded` (166 occurrences, the deleted secuura02 estate, 47 files), `gentlebush-21213dc4` (83), `blackmoss-2a7eea0b` (65), `yellowground-ae96b9b1` (58), `ashypond-b460d1a1` (11). The full list with groups and per-file line counts is `5_Project_History/2026-10-12_seatF-17th/ks812_deadhost_files_on_develop_6fa9bf7b.txt`.

| Group | Files | What |
| -- | -- | -- |
| A Shipped defaults and links | 22 (20 after KS-812) | Python SDK `sdk/python/secuura/client.py` (`DEFAULT_BASE_URL`) and `auth.py`; LibreOffice extension `auth.py` and `verifier.py`; Euro-Office `scripts/api.js`; Flutter verify app (3 `.dart`); Nextcloud app (3 `.php`); admin `M365SetupWizard.tsx` and issuer `ConnectorsPage.tsx` (manifest links); `package.json` `load-test:azure`; `scripts/generate-openapi.ts` and `docs/openapi/secuura-api.yaml` (a `servers:` entry); CSP allow-lists in the admin, issuer and verifier `nginx.conf`; `sdk/python/pyproject.toml`; and the 2 `whatsapp-bot` files KS-812 fixes |
| B Outlook add-in | 2 manifests + 2 other | `frontend/outlook-addin/manifest-azure-demo.xml` and `manifest-azure-dev.xml` (9 each), `connectors/outlook-addin/README.md`, `frontend/outlook-addin/nginx.conf` |
| C Gmail add-on | 3 | `frontend/gmail-addon/Code.gs` (6), `appsscript.json` (2), `USER_TESTING/gmail-addon-code.js` (5) |
| D Deploy env JSON | 2 | `Blockchain/Dev/deployment/azure/env.dev.json` (14), `env.demo.json` (12) |
| E Deploy scripts and deploy docs | 7 | `deployment/azure/` (`configure-domain.sh`, `deploy-all.sh`, `deploy.sh`, `env.staging.example`, `PENDING-DEPLOY.md`, `RUNBOOK.md`) and `deployment/DEPLOYMENT-ARCHITECTURE.md` |
| F Test docs and test data | 30 | `USER_TESTING/BUGS-FOR-CLI-AGENT.md` (17), `docs/E2E-TESTING-PLAN.md` (12), session notes under `USER SIMULATED TEST/`, and the rest |
| F2 Test code and test tooling | 18 | tests and test tooling that name the host |
| G Tracked Python bytecode | 3 | `__pycache__/*.pyc` under `connectors/libreoffice-extension` and `sdk/python` (should not be tracked) |
| H Other docs and rules | 12 + 1 | `Blockchain/Dev/CLI-AGENT-INSTRUCTIONS.md` (20), `CLAUDE.md` (8), `docs/AZURE-DEMO-ACCESS.md` (7), `.cursor/rules/environment-change-sync.mdc` and others |

Related: KS-812 (the `whatsapp-bot` default; the host choice, the two resolution measurements and the connector-in-no-compose check are on that PR).

nodes.title: Refs KS-1624 F1: the WhatsApp bot's banner prints the base it actually calls
Refs KS-1490: the WhatsApp bot builds one slash before /api when SECUURA_API_URL ends in one

nodes.body:
**BLUF:** Seven files on the default branch (main) contain the text `az containerapp revision restart`, a command for the deleted Container Apps estate. This ticket's description names one of them by file name only; whether its 102-file count includes the other docs is not measured.

* **How they were found:** a GitHub code search of the repository's default branch, main, on 2026-11-06. It is not a read at the develop pin c5c26b2835df, so the list is as of main. A nonsense string returned 0 results.
* **The seven paths:**
  * `Blockchain/Dev/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`
  * `Blockchain/Dev/docs/ADMINISTRATION-GUIDE.md`
  * `Blockchain/Dev/docs/OPERATIONS-RUNBOOK.md`
  * `Blockchain/Dev/ISSUER-PORTAL-TEST-REPORT.md`
  * `Blockchain/Dev/deployment/azure/redeploy-fixes.sh`
  * `Blockchain/Dev/.cursor/rules/environment-change-sync.mdc`, which this ticket's description names in its docs-and-rules group, and whose lines 120 and 121 KS-864's merge comment records as still open
  * `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/routes/system-status.ts`, the runtime hint at line 527 that KS-864 carries as its record R-1
* **What this ticket's description says:** its count is of files that name a deleted Container Apps host, and it lists the rule file's name without the other four docs or the script. The four docs and the script name a command, not necessarily the dead host, so whether they are among the 102 is unmeasured.

**NOT covered:** this seat opened none of the seven files, ran no search at the develop pin, and changed no field.

State corrected: In Review to In Progress. Half of this ticket is delivered; its main body is not.

Done: KS-812 (aa9ca9de9) fixed the two whatsapp-bot files. PR 1573 (8a9970511) fixed the doubled slash before /api when SECUURA_API_URL ends in one. PR 1580 (b5742c3e1, under KS-1624 F1) made the banner print the base the bot actually calls. All three are on develop and are ancestors of the kintsugi deploy b1fb543640e7.

Left: the sweep of tracked files that still name a dead azurecontainerapps.io host. 101 tracked files at b1fb543640e7 still contain it (git grep, with a control hit on CLI-AGENT-INSTRUCTIONS.md); the ticket's 2026-10-12 measurement was about 100 after KS-812. No commit names a group of that sweep as done.

**PR #1573 is merged to `develop` as `8a9970511f22661d92f634058fae8c08c656124f`.** The ticket stays **In Progress** — this closes only one of its two halves, and nothing is deployed.

**What landed.** When `SECUURA_API_URL` ends in a slash, the WhatsApp connector joined it to the verify path and produced a doubled separator: `https://h.test/` → `https://h.test//api/verification/verify`, `https://h.test/base//` → `https://h.test/base///api/...`. `connectors/whatsapp-bot/src/verify.ts` now strips every trailing slash from the base before the join (+2/-1), and the `ks812` shell suite gains cells for the one-, two- and three-slash shapes (+13).

**What is still open on this ticket.** The other half — roughly 100 tracked files still naming the deleted Container Apps host — is **untouched** and remains the live work here. Nothing in #1573 went near it.

**Host safety.** The gate tried 15 inputs that parse: the protocol, host and port are identical before and after in every one, and none produced a new host or a scheme change. No security-shaped finding.

**Evidence, measured by me on the tree that actually landed:** predicted commit `cd6a21b1a9`, predicted tree `d753dcc43754b945a7eef45f1a90c610e6aad68c` — which is the same `d753dcc43754` that both gates and Seat R 47th independently predicted for all four of this batch landing in any order, and it is what landed. Overlap with develop's delta 0 files, planted control reading 1. Legs on that tree: `ks812` 7 passed / 0 failed; `connectors/whatsapp-bot` `tsc --noEmit` rc 0, 0 lines, after its own `npm ci`; the **full 90-suite shell runner 90 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, rc 0** in 507 s. Five-point read after the merge 5/5 TRUE.

The shell runner was run for this PR and *not* for the other three in the batch, and that was a measurement rather than a habit: this is the only one of the four that edits `Blockchain/Dev/scripts/__tests__`, and the `scripts` subtree object id differs accordingly (`16189128e1f6` → `214ddb858e79`), where for the other three every shell-suite input subtree was byte-identical.

**Two LOW notes from gate F2 are deliberately NOT addressed here** and have their own ticket, so they are visible rather than buried: the startup banner at `index.ts:26` still prints the raw `SECUURA_API_URL` (and the `ks812` suite greps that exact banner text, so changing it needs the test edited too), and a base carrying a query string was already mis-joined and still is.

**Not tested by me:** docker, e2e, or any live request to the demo host.

**BLUF: the trailing-slash note folded in from the KS-812 gate is raised as [PR 1573](https://github.com/Secuura/Distributed_Secuura/pull/1573), head `bd935f41d0b8fd8d142c11e199448c5c44433dfa` on develop `9251ae54d`. It waits for a gate. The ticket's main body (about 100 tracked files that still name a dead Container Apps host) is not in it, so the ticket stays open. Link `contributes`.**

* The WhatsApp bot connector built `https://host//api/verification/verify` when `SECUURA_API_URL` ended in a slash; `verify.ts` now strips trailing slashes from the base once, where it is read. The default and an override without a slash are unchanged.
* Patch authored by Spark (DeepSeek V4 Flash), applied unmodified. Red-first 2 FAIL (printing the `//api` URLs) -> 7/7; the connector's own `tsc` rc 0; the full shell-suite runner on the branch 90/90. Preflight at the head: 13/16 legs ran, 3 SKIPPED (3, 4, 8: local stack not up), nothing failed — not a pass. — Seat R 47th

**Added after KS-812 merged (gate notes, folded in here as Wednesday ruled):**
- KS-812 (PR #1488) is merged as `aa9ca9de9ebcfdcc9040bfc3881fda9983dd3050`; its two `whatsapp-bot` files are therefore fixed on develop, so group A is now **20** files, not 22, and the sweep total is **100**.
- `Blockchain/Dev/connectors/whatsapp-bot/src/verify.ts:17` does not strip a trailing slash from an env override: `SECUURA_API_URL=https://host/` builds `https://host//api/verification/verify`. Pre-existing, outside KS-812, found by the Sonnet gate; fix it with the shipped-defaults group or on its own.
- The gate also noted the dead host remains in other connectors and docs (flutter-verify-app, nextcloud-app, libreoffice-extension, euro-office-plugin, outlook): that is groups A, B and H above, already listed.
